entries.name: Aluminum oxide
entries.usefulness: Proposed ICM/Orbital Engineering role: ceramic insulation, electronics substrates and wear-resistant components. An engineered ceramic grade or a specific crystal polymorph needs a separate material identity; no operating limit or crafting recipe is implied.

entries.name: Boron nitride
entries.usefulness: Proposed mod role: a separately modeled hexagonal-BN material for electrically insulating thermal management and molten-metal processing components. Generic BN stoichiometry does not identify a crystal phase; cubic BN must remain distinct.

sources.title: NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables: Boron index; Fourth Edition (1998), online index
sources.supporting_text: The index lists crystalline boron nitride with formula BN and CAS 10043-11-5. Only factual identity is retained, without thermochemical tables or gas-state properties.
sources.license_basis: Uncopyrightable factual identity/original paraphrase only, no copied tables

facts.value: For hexagonal boron nitride, the manufacturer describes thermal conduction with electrical insulation and use as a heat-dissipation filler in polymers. Filled polymers remain separate composite materials.

entries.name: Silicon carbide

entries.name: Zirconium dioxide
entries.usefulness: Proposed mod role: feedstock for separately identified stabilized ceramics, severe-service valves or oxygen-transport membranes. Stabilizer chemistry and crystal phase must be represented before assigning a performance benefit.

sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook, SRD 69: zirconium dioxide; current online identity page
sources.supporting_text: The zirconium dioxide identity gives O2Zr and CAS 1314-23-4, corresponding to ZrO2. This is not the zirconium monoxide page, which has formula OZr.
sources.license_basis: Uncopyrightable factual identity/original paraphrase only, no copied tables

facts.value: Magnesia-partially-stabilized and yttria-partially-stabilized zirconia are separately formulated ceramics used in demanding machinery applications; neither is identical to pure unstabilized ZrO2.

entries.name: Lithium fluoride
entries.usefulness: Proposed mod role: optical-component feedstock and a component in separately modeled molten-salt coolant mixtures. No nuclear recipe, lithium isotope enrichment, dosimeter dopant, molten-mixture property or coolant capacity is inferred.

sources.title: Thermo Scientific Chemicals / Fisher Scientific: Lithium fluoride, Optical Grade, product 14056
sources.supporting_text: The product identity gives FLi (equivalent to LiF), CAS 7789-24-4 and ionic SMILES. The application description lists specialized ultraviolet optics, X-ray spectrometry crystals and molten-salt-component use. No doped dosimeter identity, isotope-specific composition or mixture property is inferred.
